description: ProtocolIQ data dictionary seed. Entry ids are '<entity>.<field>' and match the governed element content, so USDM mappings and validation rules for each field are looked up live from the registry and the rules manager.

entries.name: Protocol title
entries.definition: Full official title of the clinical trial protocol.
entries.source: Title page (Builder: General Information; Digitisation: front matter)

entries.name: Protocol number
entries.definition: Sponsor's unique identifier for the protocol.

entries.name: Sponsor
entries.definition: Organisation that takes responsibility for the trial.

entries.name: Therapeutic area
entries.definition: Broad disease area of the study (free text).

entries.name: Indication
entries.definition: Disease or condition studied.

entries.name: Trial phase
entries.definition: Clinical development phase of the trial.

entries.name: Study design
entries.definition: Overall design label of the study.

entries.name: Protocol version
entries.definition: Version number of this protocol document.

entries.name: Protocol date
entries.definition: Date of this protocol version (YYYY-MM-DD).

entries.name: Amendment number
entries.definition: Identifier of the protocol amendment, if any.

entries.name: Amendment date
entries.definition: Date of the amendment (YYYY-MM-DD).

entries.name: Objective identifier
entries.definition: Short identifier of the objective (e.g. O1).

entries.name: Objective category
entries.definition: Level of the objective.

entries.name: Objective text
entries.definition: Statement of the objective.

entries.name: Endpoint identifier
entries.definition: Short identifier of the endpoint (e.g. EP1).

entries.name: Endpoint category
entries.definition: Level of the endpoint. 'Safety' is a ProtocolIQ category with no CDISC endpoint-level equivalent.

entries.name: Endpoint name
entries.definition: Short statement of what is measured.

entries.name: Endpoint definition
entries.definition: Precise definition of the endpoint.

entries.name: Measurement method
entries.definition: How the endpoint is measured.

entries.name: Endpoint timepoint
entries.definition: When the endpoint is assessed.

entries.name: Arm identifier
entries.definition: Short identifier of the treatment arm (e.g. A1).

entries.name: Arm name
entries.definition: Name of the treatment arm.

entries.name: Arm type
entries.definition: Role of the arm in the design.

entries.name: Intervention
entries.definition: Investigational product or comparator given in the arm.

entries.name: Dosage
entries.definition: Dose per administration with unit (e.g. 10 mg).

entries.name: Route of administration
entries.definition: Route by which the intervention is given.

entries.name: Dosing frequency
entries.definition: How often the intervention is given.

entries.name: Treatment duration
entries.definition: Duration of treatment in the arm.

entries.name: Comparator
entries.definition: Comparator description for the arm.

entries.name: Criterion category
entries.definition: Inclusion or exclusion.

entries.name: Criterion identifier
entries.definition: Short identifier (e.g. I1, E2).

entries.name: Criterion text
entries.definition: Full text of the eligibility criterion.

entries.name: Visit name
entries.definition: Name of the Schedule of Activities visit.

entries.name: Visit timing
entries.definition: Planned timing of the visit ('Day N' or 'Week N' relative to Day 1).

entries.name: Visit window
entries.definition: Allowed window around the planned timing (e.g. ± 3 days).

entries.name: Assessment
entries.definition: Procedure or assessment in the Schedule of Activities.

entries.name: Assessment category
entries.definition: Grouping of the assessment (e.g. Safety, Efficacy).

entries.name: SoA footnote
entries.definition: Footnote attached to visits or assessments.

entries.name: Trial type
entries.definition: Type of trial design (ICH E6 section 4).

entries.name: Randomisation
entries.definition: Whether allocation is randomised.

entries.name: Blinding
entries.definition: Blinding level of the trial.

entries.name: Planned sample size
entries.definition: Total number of participants planned.
